pr_target: dev (no PR — commit direct per AIPLA workflow)

features.description: New /lessons route + page component fetching GET /api/skills via fetchWithAuth. Anon-group + class-bound + teacher all use same component.
acceptance_criteria: Fetches GET /api/skills with the current auth token
Renders a card for each accessible skill with displayName + description
Each card links to /chat/<owner-slug>/<skill-slug> (or whatever the existing skill-path resolver produces)

features.description: Lesson card component + responsive grid. Mobile stacks; desktop grids. Same visual pattern as /teacher/classes cards for consistency.
acceptance_criteria: Cards readable on mobile (single column) and desktop (2-3 columns)
Card shows displayName (falls back to name) + description excerpt
Card click → router push to /chat URL

features.description: Empty + error states. Empty: 'Ingen lektioner tilgængelige endnu. Spørg din lærer. / No lessons available yet. Ask your teacher.' Error: dismissible banner with retry.
acceptance_criteria: Empty state copy renders when API returns []
Error state copy renders when fetch rejects

features.description: Update /group post-join redirect to /lessons. Drop the POST_JOIN_REDIRECT env-var read.
acceptance_criteria: /group page after successful join calls router.replace('/lessons')
POST_JOIN_REDIRECT env reference removed from the codebase
Existing /chat URLs still work directly (only the post-join redirect changed)

features.description: Tests + quality gates + direct-to-dev merge. vitest cases covering render, empty, error, post-join redirect. Then npm run quality:check, no emoji, FF-merge to dev.
acceptance_criteria: vitest covers happy path (renders cards), empty state, error state, retry
npm run quality:check green (lint + typecheck + tests + build)
git diff backend/ shows zero modifications
FF-merge direct to dev — no PR

queue_rationale: FE-only, no deps, small enough for a single-session run; unblocks 1.C/1.D visibility for students.
